item.title: Nobody was nowhere
item.content:encoded:
"Nobody" has always been one of my favorite GoIs/PoIs and I don't think he's (My headcannon it's a "he") always gotten the love he deserves. Even in articles that reference a lot of different GoIs (Like SCP-5000, Team-Bird, SCP-5128, Broken Masquerade, End-of-death, SCP-4989) "Nobody" is nowhere to be seen.

So (No matter your head-cannon of "Nobody"), tell me what you think "Nobody" was doing in any given apocalypse, disaster, or world-changing event.

If anyone feels up for it: a small, written tale would be pretty cool!
